title: Three To Get Deadly
author: Janet Evanovich
summary: Stephanie Plum, a New Jersey bounty hunter, gets drawn into a string of puzzling attacks around a beloved local candy man who has vanished, with her usual chaos and two rival love interests close by.
readIf: you want a breezy, wisecracking mystery that you can read in a couple of evenings.
skipIf: you prefer tightly plotted, serious detective fiction with a realistic tone.
